title: Senior Backend Engineer(Go), Storage Platform
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. What you'll be doing As part of Wolt's Platform department (Core Group), you'll help improve and automate operations for our storage access platform - our real time database abstraction layer solution designed with scale and resiliency in mind . The product you will build enforces best practices by design, abstracts database infrastructure, and supports Multi-Region architecture through data sharding and replication. You join a team of highly skilled engineers in designing, building and optimizing this platform and ensuring smooth developer onboarding, constant improvement and optimization. As an engineer on the Storage access platform team, you'll work on platform features such as UI for developer teams, storage abstraction layer, database automation, client SDK and proxy, Change Data Capture pipelines, caching and ephemeral storage, Hot & Cold storage management and more. Our humble expectations You'll be a great fit for this role if you have the following skills and experience: A strong developer-to-developer mindset, with a genuine enjoyment of building for internal customers and treating other engineers as your primary users. Adaptability and strong motivation for working with distributed systems. A data-driven approach to decision-making and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to navigate disagreements constructively and deliver consistently. Autonomy in dynamic, fast-paced environments with frequent change. A product- and platform-oriented approach to engineering challenges. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments. Technical proficiencies: Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB. Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability. Familiarity with SRE principles; however, a background in Backend Development is essential. Practical knowledge of Kubernetes, including EKS, as an end user. You don't need to tick every box, but if you see yourself in many of these points, we'd love to hear from you! What we offer At Wolt, we're committed to building an environment where engineers can make an impact while enjoying meaningful challenges. As a member of the the team you'll enjoy: Working on solutions that support millions of users Solving complex problems in performance, reliability and automation A collaborative and inclusive culture that supports your professional and personal well-being We also offer flexible work arrangements, competitive compensation, and ongoing learning opportunities to help you thrive. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Getting homes off fossil fuels means fitting millions of heat pumps, solar panels and batteries, and every one has to be designed, sold and fitted by an installer. The assets themselves already work brilliantly, but getting them into homes is still slow, complex and painful. Our mission is to change that: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run a renewables installation business, and get homes off fossil fuels way faster. In just a few years we've become the leading platform for heat pump installers in the UK and Ireland, with around half of all heat pump installations now being managed on Spruce. We've just launched our solar and battery product, and we're building on that to go after even bigger opportunities: every other type of job these installers do, the rest of how they run their business, and a bunch of new countries. We're now on the hunt for truly brilliant engineers to help us move faster and go further. 🌲 About Spruce Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates. We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and this year have doubled the team and grown revenue 4x. We've expanded into Ireland, have just launched an end-to-end solar and battery product, and are increasingly becoming the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed… 🥖 The Role You'll work closely with a small, high-calibre team of engineers, designers and domain experts to build and scale the tools that power our installer software, owning and delivering complex features end-to-end from day one. The problem space is deep and varied, including: Heat loss modelling and hydronic system design 2D and 3D floor-plan tooling using LiDAR and computer vision Large-scale data ingestion and geospatial analysis Offline-first, collaborative PWAs Hardware integrations (Bluetooth measurement tools, sensors, monitoring systems) This is not CRUD-only work. You'll be working on meaningful production problems from day one that blend physical reality, real-world constraints, and serious impact. 🥞 Tech Stack Our tech stack strives for simplicity, symmetry and efficiency. Our hard problems come from the real world instead of self-made architectural problems. You don't need to know all of the below, but you do need an appetite for full stack mastery and owning the problem end to end: Docker, Docker Compose PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Atlas migrations Node, Prisma React, TypeScript, Konva, Tailwind 🫵 About You We look for the same five things in everyone at Spruce: curiosity; intense drive, ambition and work ethic; a high degree of personal agency and ownership; deep humility and a growth mindset; and excellent craft. We're hiring at mid-level: you've probably been shipping production code for a few years. We care less about titles and more about impact, judgment, and intent. You'll likely have experience with: Modern JavaScript / TypeScript and frontend frameworks Backend development and API design Relational databases and data modelling But more importantly, you are: Product-minded – you want to understand real users and real problems, not just tickets; Impact-driven – you balance technical quality with momentum and know when "good enough" is exactly right; Comfortable with ownership – you take responsibility for outcomes, not just code; Candid and collaborative – you challenge ideas openly, receive feedback well, and optimise for the team over ego; Already using AI intensively – you use it every day to make yourself disproportionately more effective, and you can show us how. … and you'll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓 🌟 Our offer 💰 £50–100k salary, depending on experience 🍰 Equity (options) in the company 🏡 Hybrid working: 2 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight 🏖️ 33 days holiday (25 plus bank holidays) and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year 🏥 Private Medical Cover (Vitality) 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme ( YellowNest ) 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow 🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce We're currently a close-knit team of 35, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2–3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone together every fortnight. You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense. We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions. We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it and what we can learn – and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back. Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back. title: Client Services Manager - Bridging
description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description The Bridging Department at Allica Bank is a high-energy, specialist lending team supporting established SMEs and professional property investors with fast, flexible short-term finance. Operating within a true challenger-bank environment, the team combines strong credit discipline with pragmatic decision-making, relationship-led lending, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcomes for customers. This is a fast-paced and constantly evolving department where no two days are the same. Deals are time-critical, varied, and often bespoke, requiring commercial thinking, sound judgement, and a willingness to take ownership from day one. As the Bridging proposition continues to grow, the role and the department evolve week by week. The team is lively, proactive, and highly collaborative. People are trusted to act like owners, take responsibility for their decisions, and work closely with colleagues across Distribution, Credit, Operations, and external partners to keep things moving. There is a strong emphasis on keeping things clear and simple, working at pace, and removing unnecessary barriers to getting good deals done. True to Allica’s values, the Bridging Department is built on teamwork, transparency, and doing the right thing for customers and the Bank. Ideas are welcomed, expertise is respected, and individuals are encouraged to challenge constructively, improve processes, and contribute to the continued success of a growing SME-focused lender. Role Description The Client Services – Team Lead is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Client Services Associates and Managers, driving high performance, accountability, and strong credit outcomes. The role plays a key part in building capability across the team, supporting individual development plans and succession planning, and fostering a culture where the team feel confident to challenge, escalate, and continuously improve. Alongside people leadership, the role holds responsibility for packaging and structuring complex bridging transactions, ensuring lending decisions align with the Bank’s Credit Policy, risk appetite, and asset strategy, while delivering fast, high quality outcomes for SME and professional property clients. The Client Services -Team Lead plays a critical role within Allica Bank’s Bridging proposition, supporting the delivery of fast, flexible lending solutions to SME and professional property clients. Client Services are responsible for working with the BDMs in increasing originations, structuring Indicative Terms and carrying out an initial assessment of borrowing requests to evaluate feasibility and alignment with the Bank’s credit appetite. Acting as the first point of “triage”, the role determines whether enquiries are suitable to progress, ensuring only well-structured, viable applications are submitted to Credit. This early intervention is fundamental to maintaining pace, quality, and conversion through the lending journey. The role works closely alongside Business Development Managers and the Credit team, supporting the effective transition of enquiries into fully packaged applications. Client Services Associates prepare high-quality files for submission, ensuring key information is captured accurately and efficiently to support timely credit decisioning. The Client Services – Team Lead may also be involved in originating, structuring, and progressing bridging applications from Introducers and Borrowers, from initial enquiry through to completion. Client Services act as a trusted point of contact for brokers, providing clarity, guidance, and responsiveness throughout the early stages of the process. The role also involves liaising with third parties such as surveyors and solicitors, coordinating activity to help drive cases smoothly towards completion. Principal Accountabilities  Provide clear day-to-day leadership to the Client Services team, setting expectations on quality, pace, and behaviours.  Own the allocation of new and existing bridging cases, ensuring fair distribution.  Actively manage the pipeline to maintain momentum on time-critical transactions and Reallocate work where necessary to avoid delays or bottlenecks  Serve as the primary escalation and guidance point for questions from the team.  Coach and develop the team through regular feedback, case reviews, and on-the-job learning.  Conduct regular case reviews, quality assurance, and feedback sessions. Generate Indicative Terms and progress loan applications within agreed service level agreements (SLAs), utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools.  Proactively manage the application journey from initial enquiry through to completion, coordinating effectively with panel solicitors, valuers, project monitors, asset managers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely instruction, accurate documentation, and smooth case progression.  Undertake regular checks, Customer due diligence, and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times, escalating immediately any areas of concern.  Produce clear, accurate, and concise written documentation to support high-quality credit decisioning, making well-reasoned recommendations to the Credit team and ensuring all activity is accurately recorded and maintained within CRM systems.  Liaise effectively with applicants, intermediaries, valuers, solicitors, and other third parties to obtain additional information required to support applications and resolve issues efficiently through to completion.  Deliver a consistently high standard of service to customers, brokers, Relationship Managers, and Business Development Managers, building and maintaining strong, trusted relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards  Actively support external Business Development Managers by identifying, developing, and nurturing new broker and customer opportunities, contributing to the growth of the Bridging proposition and conversion of enquiries into applications  Ensure full compliance with all mandatory policies, regulatory requirements, and credit procedures, maintaining robust internal controls and governance standards at all times Support the development and ongoing enhancement of management information (MI) and key performance indicators (KPIs), maintaining accurate and timely reporting to provide clear visibility of the mortgage and bridging processing pipeline  Proactively identify opportunities for improvement across the Bank and the Client Services team, taking ownership for delivering enhancements and setting a positive example through behaviours aligned to Allica’s values  Where applicable, complete monthly assurance and quality assurance dip-testing on cases agreed for direct reports, providing clear feedback, guidance, and development support as required. Personal Attributes & Experience  Credible leader who builds trust quickly with underwriters, brokers, and senior stakeholders.  Demonstrable experience leading, coaching, or mentoring underwriters.  Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and confidence in decision-making.  Balance speed with risk discipline, ensuring complex or higher-risk cases receive appropriate senior input  Strong experience in the Bridging sector, with an understanding of the competitive landscape, key market dynamics, and current trends in short-term property finance.  Strong analytical capability combined with clear, confident verbal and written communication skills, enabling the role holder to assess enquiries effectively and communicate decisions, rationale, and next steps clearly to brokers, customers, and internal stakeholders.  A pragmatic and confident problem-solver who consistently stands out from their peers through the ability to assess complex scenarios, apply sound commercial judgement, and clearly justify decisions in line with the Bank’s credit appetite and customer outcomes.  Highly organised with excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, able to deliver accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced, time-critical environment while managing multiple cases simultaneously.  A relationship-led professional who builds strong, trusted, and lasting relationships with internal stakeholders including Distribution, Operations, Credit, and senior management, as well as with external partners such as intermediaries, valuers, and solicitors.  Demonstrates a strong understanding of, and commitment to, regulatory requirements, internal policies, procedures, risk controls, and service level expectations, with a disciplined and responsible approach to governance.  Good working knowledge of Treating Customers Fairly (TCF), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and Conduct Risk, with a clear focus on doing the right thing for customers and the Bank.  Confident and capable user of technology, with experience of CRM systems and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word to support effective case management, reporting, and documentation. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast. Back in 2009, our Chairman Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans. Since then we've become the nation's favourite way to move, with over 150k five-star reviews and 5 million customers in the UK and Europe. Our team of 400 AnyVanners across London, Cape Town and Bogota is proving that moving doesn't have to cost the earth by helping save 8,520 tonnes of Carbon each year. Build systems that move the real world, with AI at the core At AnyVan, we're building one of the most sophisticated logistics optimisation platforms in Europe. We connect customer demand with real-time driver availability, using intelligent matching, dynamic pricing, and AI to deliver a world-class service at market-beating prices. By routing jobs to vans already on the road, we reduce wasted miles, cut emissions, and ensure drivers earn fairly. It's logistics, pricing, and marketplace dynamics, driven by software and increasingly by machine intelligence. We're hiring for two Senior Engineer roles. Both sit in the same engineering team, share the same stack and ways of working, and put AI at the heart of what they build. The difference is the problem you'll focus on: one role is all about the AI agents behind our Sales and Customer Service teams, the other is about Allocations, getting our transport partners matched to the right jobs. Let us know in your application which one interests you most. Role 1: Senior Engineer, AI Agents (Sales & Customer Service) In this role, you'll help build and scale the AI agents behind our Sales and Customer Service teams. These agents handle real conversations with real customers every day, answering questions, qualifying leads, quoting moves and resolving issues across phone, chat and messaging. You'll own them end to end, from designing how they reason and which tools and data they can use, to the evaluation, guardrails and observability that keep them accurate, on-brand and safe in production. You'll work closely with our Sales and CS leaders and the agents who use these tools on the front line, so you can see the impact of your work in conversion, response times and customer satisfaction. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to move LLM-powered systems past the demo stage and into something thousands of customers rely on. Role 2: Senior Engineer, Allocations In this role, you'll work with our Allocations team on the data and back-end engineering problems behind how our transport partners access jobs, get booked and are allocated against the right work. You'll focus on the data, platforms and tools that make that happen. This is the engine behind routing jobs to vans already on the road, so you'll see the impact of your work directly in how efficiently jobs are matched and how fairly drivers earn. We move fast: We're embedding AI and machine learning across our core platform, not as experiments, but as production systems that drive real business outcomes: Real-time, intelligent pricing that models true job-level costs and responds dynamically to supply, demand, and market conditions Predictive demand and routing models that forecast driver availability and optimise job allocation before a customer even books LLM-powered tooling across our internal and customer-facing products, from intelligent quoting to driver workflow automation A two-sided marketplace where drivers can buy and sell jobs to maximise utilisation — powered by smart matching algorithms This is genuinely leading-edge work: production AI systems, at scale, on problems that matter. How our engineering teams deliver We're product-led and agile. Most teams run Scrum with two-week sprints, but we care far more about outcomes than rituals. Engineers are trusted to challenge assumptions, adapt processes, and ship things that matter. Senior engineers here are not heads-down implementers. You'll: Work closely with product, data, and commercial stakeholders Influence technical direction and architectural decisions Balance speed with long-term sustainability Regularly ship meaningful improvements to production Our technology We're pragmatic and cloud-first, running on AWS, with the flexibility to choose the right tool for the job: Exploring: Go, Rust, React, Node.js Core stack: Python, Vue.js & Nuxt, TypeScript Legacy (retiring where we can): Java, PHP, Angular You don't need experience in everything, we value strong fundamentals and good engineering judgement over keyword matching. What you'll be doing Designing, building, and operating production-grade systems that scale Tackling complex technical challenges across backend, infrastructure, data flows, and AI/ML pipelines Writing clean, pragmatic, well-tested code with long-term maintainability in mind Collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders to shape solutions Championing testing, observability, and quality improvements Mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across the team You'll thrive here if you have Experience in a scale-up or fast-growing product environment Strong backend engineering skills (Go, Java, Python, or similar) A solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and performance Experience with CI/CD, modern deployment practices, and cloud infrastructure Comfort working with ambiguity and evolving requirements A bias toward action — shipping value quickly, then iterating A collaborative mindset and the ability to influence beyond your code Bonus: exposure to AI/ML systems, Building AI agents, marketplaces, logistics, pricing, or e-commerce Location and eligibility UK-based, able to commute to Hammersmith. Happy to be onsite at least 3 days per week. Please note we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role at this time. What we offer 💰 Highly competitive salary 🌴 25 days holiday + bank holidays, Christmas Eve off, long-service perks up to 30 days 💪 On-site gym, Vitality membership, enhanced sick pay 📈 Pension – 5% employee / 3% employer 👶 Enhanced maternity pay 🚲 2 minutes from the tube, EV schemes, cycle-to-work, showers & towels ☕ Barista coffee, free breakfast, local discounts 🎉 Weekly drinks, socials, and unforgettable incentive trips 🚀 High ownership, real impact, and the chance to help shape a scaling platform Our company values are: Have fun, get it done Progress over perfection One team thinking big You can find out more about our Company, Culture and Values here: Our Careers Page General FAQ's Our Culture DE&I We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace where every voice is heard, every perspective is valued, and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. title: Head of Operations (12 Month Cover)
description: Head of Operations (Cover – 9 to 12 Months) Location: London (Hybrid) Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (9–12 Months) with possibility to extend for the right candidate. Department: Operations Reports to: CEO About us Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit. We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked. Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space. We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK. This is Foundational. Position Overview We’re scaling fast- and we’re looking for a sharp, hands-on Head of Operations with a genuine "lets go" attitude to step in for a 9 to 12-month cover and keep our momentum strong. In a high-growth startup environment, you’ll sit at the center of the business—bridging People (HR), Day-to-Day Operations, and Finance to build the scalable structure we need to grow without losing our speed. This isn’t a "keep the seat warm" role. As the company expands, things move quickly and sometimes get messy. You’ll jump straight in to turn chaos into clarity—putting smart structure, repeatable workflows, and financial and people operations in place so our team can execute at full pace, with a smooth handover at both ends of the contract. Key Responsibilities Operations & Scalable Structure Design and implement lightweight, repeatable processes and internal systems that support rapid company scaling without creating red tape. Own day-to-day business operations and tooling to remove bottlenecks and keep cross-functional teams moving fast. Track company-wide KPIs and OKRs, running regular operational check-ins with department leads to flag risks early. Manage vendor relationships, software stack, office/hybrid logistics, and compliance requirements as headcount grows. title: Machine Learning Researcher
description: <h3>About the Position</h3> <p>Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we've selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You'll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models.</p> <p>At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges—large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques.</p> <p>You'll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we're still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes.</p> <p>Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication.</p> <h3>About you</h3> <p>If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:</p> <ul> <li>An undergraduate, PhD student, or postdoc with practical experience working on ML problems</li> <li>Interested in applying logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problems</li> <li>Curious about the machine learning landscape and excited to apply state-of-the-art techniques drawn from many problem domains</li> <li>Fluent with a versatile set of models and tricks</li> <li>Able to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas in Python and your favourite ML framework</li> <li>Eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things</li> <li>Fluent in English</li> </ul> <p>If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/ml-research-interviews">interview process</a> and <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/get-to-know-us/">meet some of the team</a>. Learn more about Jane Street's internship program <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/internships/">here</a>.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. They need rapid access to data, analytics outputs, and processing through GUIs, APIs and other systems, whilst being given the confidence that everything is compliant, licenced and well-governed. Our scale and model complexity has now reached a point that to continue to achieve our business vision, we are building a dedicated global Platform team.  </p> <p>We will be looking for experienced software engineers to join as core members of this team to help architect, implement and support the tools that will be fundamental to Baringa’s ongoing growth and success. </p> <p>This is a high calibre team, where curiosity and a thirst to understand the problem space is not just encouraged, but prioritised. There will be a range of engineering challenges to solve at all levels, requiring the flexibility to adopt the right technology for a given problem space. Our next generation platform will be core to driving significant improvements to the lives and capabilities of our Baringa colleagues in the energy modelling space. Successful candidates will be given responsibility and freedom from day one, trusted to challenge and be challenged in turn, in an environment that rewards creativity and entrepreneurship as we build the foundations for Baringa’s future. </p> <p>Come and join us to be part of the energy transition, the defining challenge of our lifetimes, where your technical skills and experience can have real impact. <span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"201341983":0,"335559738":200,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span> </span></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing:</span></span></h3> <p>We will be looking for an experienced software engineer to be a core member of the new Platform team, working closely with the Engineering Lead. You will assist the Engineering Lead in the selection of technologies and approaches to build everything from big data platforms through to browser plugins and shared functional libraries.</li> <li>Work closely with the Engineering Lead to engage tool developers, energy system modellers, client facing energy experts and users across the business to build a platform and supporting toolchain reliability and monitoring is built-in from inception. </li> <li>Work with the team to build a DevOps pipeline with robust CI and CD practices, with a focus on evolving our processes to improve our team’s engineering experience. </li> <li>Be an active part of the team’s agile development approach, from refinement through to demonstration and feedback, helping drive the continuous improvement of team processes as we grow and mature.  </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience:</span></span><strong><span style="color: that enable market-leading insights for our clients.</p> <ul> <li>You are passionate about building the ‘right’ solution to problems, and understanding the ‘why’ behind what you’re building to support Baringa’s work in the energy sector.</li> <li>You have practical experience as a senior engineer in highly motivated engineering team(s), collaborating closely with colleagues and taking pride in what title: Business Development Representative
description: About us Every large organisation runs on a web of legal entities, and the data behind them is scattered across in-house teams, law firms and accountants in PDFs, spreadsheets and slide decks. Jigsaw brings it into one place. We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. Today 240+ organisations use Jigsaw, including all 10 of the world’s top 10 accountancy firms. Now we’re building Entity Lifecycle Management: one live record for every entity, from formation to dissolution. Founded by former lawyer and repeat founder Stephen Scanlan, and backed by Exor Ventures. Why join us : You’ll help define a new software category with the backing of a loyal, global customer base. We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action, then trust them to do their best work. The role The primary role will be to seek new business opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential customers. You will use your initiative to discover leads, reaching out to prospects and building interest in Jigsaw. You will work closely with the Business Development team, executing the Account Executives’ targeted campaigns, as well as independently driving your own outreach. Working in a startup presents variety and multiple opportunities to take on additional responsibilities to expand beyond your normal role. Things can move fast and we’re looking for someone flexible and driven, with a natural ability to learn and quickly adapt. This is a fantastic opportunity to springboard into the exciting world of entrepreneurialism, offering potential for fast career growth and in-depth exposure to starting and growing a business. This is not just a job. If you are motivated, enjoy working in a dynamic team environment and would like to be part of the technology revolution, we’d like you to join us on our journey. Responsibilities Proactively seek new business opportunities in the market Contact potential clients through cold calls and emails Set up meetings or calls between (prospective) clients and Account Executives Report on (weekly/monthly/quarterly) sales results Requirements Excellent communication and people skills, including the ability to ‘think on your feet’ Ability to organize and prioritize workload Proven track record of achieving and exceeding goals Adaptability and resilience Prior Business Development experience is a bonus Based in or willing to relocate to London area Compensation: £33K • Offers Equity • £7.5K – £10K Commission • Uncapped Entry Level - London • Base salary £33K • Offers Equity • £7.5K – £10K Commission • Uncapped Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Head of People Business Partnering
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. You'll lead a team of four - a People Business Partner Lead and People Business Partners - spanning the UK and APAC. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, global technology business, brings strong commercial instincts, and knows how to build trusted relationships within the team, and at every level of the organisation. 🚀 What you'll own Lead, develop, and inspire a team of four People BPs globally, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and commercially-minded team culture. Partner closely with the Chief People Officer and Chief of Staff to shape and execute Kraken's people strategy, ensuring it reflects the culture, and the needs of a rapidly growing and changing global business. Drive organisational effectiveness initiatives including restructures, role design, capability building, and team design, partnering cross-functionally to ensure execution is smooth and thoughtful. Champion data-led people practices - using workforce insights and people analytics to inform decisions and demonstrate impact. Represent the People BP function in leadership forums, contributing to the broader People Capability agenda and influencing how we attract, develop, and retain talent globally. Support Kraken's international growth by providing people partnering expertise as we enter new markets and scale existing ones. Build strong relationships with COE partners (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, L&D, and People Operations) to ensure a consistent people experience developed with our culture in mind. 🧠 What you bring to the party Significant experience in senior People Business Partnering or HR leadership roles (10 years), ideally within a fast-growing technology or global organisation. Proven track record of leading and developing a team of People BPs, with the ability to coach, delegate, and agree clear direction. A credible and confident communicator with demonstrated experience influencing C-suite and senior business stakeholders. Deep understanding of the full people partner toolkit - org design, workforce planning, talent management, succession, and complex ER. Data-literate with the ability to use people insights to shape strategy and tell compelling stories to stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen; you understand how people decisions drive business outcomes and can connect the dots between the two. Experience operating across multiple geographies and time zones, with an understanding of employment frameworks in the UK, Europe, and ideally APAC. Ability to operate with pace and pragmatism in an ambiguous, high-growth environment while maintaining rigour and quality in delivery. Collaborative by nature - you build bridges across teams and bring people with you, rather than working in silos. ⭐️ Bonus points Experience in the energy, utilities, or climate tech sector. Exposure to scaling teams and organisations through rapid growth phases. Experience supporting international expansion, including standing up people partnering capability in new markets. In-house legal runs on inboxes, chat threads and tools that weren’t built for it. Wordsmith is changing that. We’re building the platform in-house legal runs on. Requests from across the business come in through one front door. AI agents handle the routine work. Lawyers stay in control where judgment matters. Legal finally gets to triage by risk, not by whoever shouted loudest. We’re built for in-house teams, not law firms. Our customers want to spend less on outside counsel, not more, and we’re on their side of that equation. More than 500 companies run on Wordsmith, including Financial Times, Canva, Trip.com, Revolut, Adyen, Trustpilot, and Sage. We’ve raised $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, and we’re growing fast. The role We're hiring an Enablement Lead to own how customers learn Wordsmith, and how they become confident, self-sufficient users of it. You'll own onboarding, training and enablement end to end: Legal AI fundamentals, product and feature overviews, self-paced certifications, and re-enablement for customers who've stalled. You'll teach both ends of the customer organisation: the lawyers and business users in Wordsmith every day, and the champions and admins who support their colleagues. This is an enablement role, not a delivery or commercial one. You won't own implementation, technical support, renewals, account growth or a sales quota. Your focus is capability: do customers know how to use Wordsmith well, and can they keep learning without us? What you'll do Own customer onboarding. Design and run the journey that takes a newly implemented customer to a confident, capable team, and keep improving it. Teach Legal AI fundamentals. Build the curriculum that helps legal teams understand what AI agents do well, where judgement stays with them, and how to work alongside the technology. Run live training. Lead onboarding sessions, product walkthroughs and feature deep dives for lawyers, business users and admins of every technical confidence level. Build the self-paced academy. Create online certifications and learning paths so customers can train new joiners and refresh skills on their own. Maintain the enablement library. Keep guides and product overviews accurate as Wordsmith ships, and retire what's out of date. Re-enable struggling customers. Diagnose why adoption has stalled and run focused programmes that get teams back to self-sufficiency. Train the champions. Equip customer champions and admins to teach their own colleagues, so capability compounds inside each account. Shape in-app help. Work with Product to build guidance, walkthroughs and prompts into Wordsmith itself. Measure whether learning worked. Define what a trained, self-sufficient customer looks like, track it, and use the evidence to change what we teach. Partner across customer teams. Work with Transformation, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product so enablement reflects real implementations, questions and product changes. What we're looking for 3–5 years in customer enablement, training, onboarding, customer education, implementation or a similar customer-facing role where teaching was central. You design learning, not just deliver it. You can turn a complex product into a curriculum with a clear sequence and outcomes. Confidence in front of a room, in person and on video, with senior lawyers as readily as with day-to-day users. Experience building self-paced content (courses, certifications, guides, video) and a view on what makes people finish it. A clear, warm communication style that makes unfamiliar ideas easy to grasp without oversimplifying them. Strong organisation: you can run several programmes, sessions and content deadlines at once without losing detail. Comfort with data. You can read product-usage information, spot where learning hasn't landed and act on it. Curiosity about AI and legal technology. You don't need a legal background, but you'll want to learn the product and our customers' work deeply. A strong learning mindset: you welcome feedback, apply coaching and want to grow quickly. How we work We're an hybrid team in Edinburgh or London, so expect to work from the office or visit customers by default. We set a high bar, move quickly and give people real ownership. There won't always be a playbook, so you'll bring curiosity, structure and persistence. You'll work closely with the VP of Transformation and with Customer Success, Account Management and Product. Each customer team has a clear remit: Transformation leads implementation Support Engineering resolves technical issues Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability Why join Wordsmith Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding inside larger organisations. Because Legal AI is new to almost everyone who buys it, teaching it well is one of the highest-leverage things we can do. You'll join early enough to define what customer enablement at Wordsmith is: the curriculum, the certifications, and the standard for what a confident user looks like. You'll work directly with ambitious legal teams, learn the product deeply and develop fast in a high-performing team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Lead SDLC and DevOps engagements across planning, development, testing, release management and continuous improvement. Help clients adopt automation and AI-enabled workflows—including Atlassian Rovo—responsibly, with appropriate security and governance. Advise senior stakeholders, lead discovery and solution design, and contribute to complex presales, estimates, proposals and demonstrations. Deep Atlassian consulting experience, especially Jira and Confluence, including independently leading complex Data Center-to-Cloud migrations. Scripting, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, platform engineering, observability or SRE. Developing consulting offerings, delivery methods, accelerators or technical training. title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description: At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for low-level and high-level software in CesiumAstro’s products through all phases of the development process. Key projects will include Linux-based single-board computers and high-reliability microcontroller systems. CesiumAstro’s goal is to create an out-of-the-box hardware and software experience which enhances our customers’ ability to rapidly integrate our products into their systems. As a CesiumAstro software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices. The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Designing and implementing software for embedded devices and systems, from requirements to production and commercial deployment. Designing, developing, coding, testing, debugging, and documenting system software. Reviewing code and system designs. Analyzing code for efficiency, stability, and scalability. Integrating and validating new product designs. Supporting software quality assurance and optimizing I/O performance. Providing post-production/in-orbit customer support. Interfacing with hardware design and development engineers. Assessing third-party and open-source software. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS A Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering. 4+ years of industry experience in software development. Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of embedded hardware. API design for interfacing with FPGAs. Experience with products for aerospace applications. Programming experience in C or C++. Experience in embedded systems design with preemptive, multitasking real-time operating systems (experience with real-time Linux is desirable). Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer review. Excellent knowledge of real-time system coding techniques, IP protocols, interfaces, and hardware subsystems. Excellent understanding of multi-threaded applications and resource management. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Adequate knowledge of reading electronics schematics and component data sheets. Experience with ARM processors and fully-featured microcontrollers. Experience in the design and development of a Software Development Kit (SDK). CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organisation. Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees. title: Principal, Revenue Marketing (International)
description: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies. Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures. We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD. ABOUT THE TEAM Immuta’s marketing team sits at the intersection of data, AI, and enterprise growth. We turn a complex, important market problem into clear stories and meaningful connections with the people and organizations Immuta serves. We are building a thoughtful, modern marketing organization—one that values strong fundamentals, smart experimentation, useful data, and the judgment to know when a local insight should change the broader conversation. This team brings Immuta’s global story to life in markets around the world. We work across cultures, customer needs, and market dynamics while staying connected to a shared purpose and a high standard of execution. For marketers who enjoy learning quickly, making sense of complexity, and helping a growing company earn trust in new markets, this is an opportunity to have visible impact with a genuinely global team. ABOUT THE ROLE As Principal, Revenue Marketing (International), you will help shape how Immuta shows up in markets beyond its home base. This individual contributer role offers unusual strategic latitude: you will bring together customer insight, commercial context, and a point of view on where the company can create the most value. You will have the opportunity to influence the way Immuta earns attention, builds credibility, and grows relationships across a diverse set of international audiences. You’ll be part of a team that values clear thinking, thoughtful challenge, and momentum. The work will suit someone who enjoys navigating ambiguity, connecting people around a shared direction, and turning good ideas into progress. You will have visibility with senior partners across the business, the freedom to use your judgment, and the chance to help define how an ambitious data and AI company grows around the world. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Set international marketing strategy, priorities, operating rhythms, and annual plans across priority markets. Translate global go-to-market strategy into integrated regional programs spanning field, partner, digital, account-based, event, content, and campaign marketing. Own international marketing contribution to target-account engagement, meeting creation, sourced pipeline, influenced pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue growth. Create repeatable AI-enabled workflows and scalable planning processes that improve the speed, quality, relevance, and efficiency of international marketing programs. Partner with regional Sales and Alliances leaders to align on market priorities, account focus, campaign plans, follow-up motions, and performance expectations. Develop partner-led growth through measurable co-marketing programs with strategic technology, cloud, channel, and ecosystem partners. Localize global campaigns, messaging, content, and offers for local audiences while bringing market insight to Product Marketing, Content, Corporate Marketing, and other central teams. Define performance metrics and reporting, analyze results by market and program, and improve investment decisions based on engagement, conversion, pipeline, and return. Manage budgets, agencies, vendors, event investments, and partner resources against clear international priorities, while mentoring peers and raising the quality of work across Marketing. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE International Scope: B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing experience across multiple international markets, with ownership of strategy and outcomes. Strategic Ownership: Experience setting international priorities, allocating resources, and delivering sourced or influenced pipeline, opportunities, revenue, account engagement, or market expansion. AI Marketing: Hands-on use of generative AI and AI-powered tools for market intelligence, segmentation, localization, content, personalization, campaign optimization, or analytics; ability to turn experiments into repeatable workflows. Integrated Marketing: Ownership across field, partner, demand, digital, events, content, and campaign marketing, balancing global consistency with local relevance. Executive Influence: Ability to advise senior Sales, Alliances, Marketing, and business leaders; align stakeholders; and communicate recommendations and tradeoffs clearly. Resource Management: Experience influencing international marketing investments and managing agencies, vendors, partners, event investments, or distributed resources. Partner Marketing: Experience building joint go-to-market and measurable co-marketing programs with technology, cloud, channel, or ecosystem partners. Analytics and Operations: Ability to define metrics, interpret funnel and pipeline data, build repeatable planning processes, improve execution, mentor peers, and lead without formal authority. BENEFITS At Immuta, our goal is to help bridge the gap between personal and professional growth, so that our team members can be well and thrive personally and professionally. After all, great professional success stories rarely happen without great personal success stories! Our generous benefits package given to all full time employees includes: 100% employer paid Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision) premiums for you and your dependents (including Domestic Partners) Stock Options Paid parental leave (Both Maternity and Paternity) Unlimited Paid time off (U.S. based positions) Learning and Development Resources EEO NOTICE: Immuta provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, age, disability (including disability due to pregnancy) or genetics, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Immuta complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment. NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY RECRUITERS: Immuta does not accept candidates from third party recruiters. All candidates submitted through are considered to be submissions by the candidate and no submission will obligate Immuta to pay any third party for the referral or hiring of a candidate. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><div> <p><strong>THE WORK:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build and operate the digital-asset infrastructure behind Prisma, our event-driven platform that gives internal teams access to custody providers, wallets, and liquidity partners. You’ll focus on how assets move and are held across the platform: wallet and vault integrations, deposit and withdrawal flows, balance tracking and reconciliation, and portfolio and fund management across accounts. You’ll also contribute to related digital-asset projects such as liquidity management, asset collections, and liquidation services, including controls like maker-checker approvals and segregation of duties.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Integrate with new bank APIs and normalize to the internal system schema. Solving any bespoke integration approaches that will come up.</li> <li>Advance the system forward to an optimal state with clear boundaries and responsibilities</li> <li>Work on our internal trading system (Prisma)</li> <li>Work on a variety of challenges spanning crypto, trading, fintech, and payment solutions.</li> <li>Fully integrate into a large system and spot opportunities for improvements and best practices.</li> <li>Prototype new solutions for complex software problems and implement them for production cloud deployments</li> </ul> </div> <div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BRING: </strong></p> </div> <div> <ul> <li>Experience building highly scalable and performant enterprise software</li> <li>Working knowledge of Java and its ecosystem (i.e. threading, concurrency ... etc).</li> <li>A positive attitude and a passion for sharing knowledge - the go-to person on the team for small and large questions</li> <li>Interest in fintech, markets, and trading is a must.</li> <li>Knowledge or high interest in our main tools: Java, event-driven architectures (AMQP or similar), gRPC, service meshes, etc.</li> <li>Obsession with finishing projects properly, with good stakeholder management, communications, and documentation.</li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>WHO WE ARE:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Do Your Best Work</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take Control of Your Finances</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Employee giving match</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mobile phone stipend</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take Care of Yourself</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">R&R days so you can rest and recharge</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Industry-leading parental leave policies. title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role Overview You will design satellite structure and hardware, and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised and under control as the design matures. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, including secondary structures (panels, brackets and component mounts), thermal-control hardware, cable and harness routing, and mechanisms. Primary structure experience is welcome. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, using top-down design and skeleton models to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Manage assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce fully dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings and interface control documents using GD&T. Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers on analysis and verification planning. Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline. 3+ years' experience in mechanical design of aerospace, space or other high-reliability hardware, with strong 3D CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Demonstrated ability to design, build and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience Satellite or spacecraft design, ideally detailed design of secondary structures (panel and component mounting, thermal hardware, cable and harness routing). Primary structure experience is a plus. Experience working in large, multi-person CAD assemblies, including top-down design, skeleton or master models, in-context references and configurations. Experience with PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM), configuration management, revision control and formal change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience working within formal engineering processes, such as design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity, MGSE or ground-support equipment design, and electromechanical packaging. Why NewOrbit Space? Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.
