title: [2028 graduates] Intern (Antitrust & Competition Economics Practice) - Summer 2027
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><strong><a href="http://www.crai.com/">Charles River Associates</a></strong> is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world.  CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.</p> <p>CRA's <strong><a href="https://ecp.crai.com/">European Competition practice</a></strong> specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.</p> <p>We have played a key role in many cases that have shaped European competition policy in recent years: from aerospace to software, and manufacturing to transportation. More recently, we have been at the forefront of economic thinking in antitrust investigations and regulation in the tech sector.</p> <p><em>We seek candidates for our London, UK location.</em></p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>Our <a href="https://www.crai.com/careers/intern-program/">Summer Analyst/Associate Internship program</a> mirrors the analyst experience to give you an understanding of our business and experience project work at Charles River Associates. Throughout the 8-10 week program, Analyst/Associate Interns work alongside senior colleagues to deliver live client consulting projects within the practice area. Along the way, you’ll benefit from professional development and wellness support programs, social events to connect you with peers and a collegial work environment. Successful interns will be offered a full-time position following graduation.</p> <p>Interns work closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to assist on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe. A typical Intern would:</p> <ul> <li>Identify potential issues and conduct analyses that can be used to illustrate economic arguments;</li> <li>Assemble compelling evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations;</li> <li>Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;</li> <li>Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using financial, market, industry or client-proprietary data;</li> <li>Communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to internal teams in an understandable, accessible manner;</li> <li>Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications </strong></p> <ul> <li>Pursuing an undergraduate degree in economics from well-regarded institutions, graduating between December 2027 and August 2028;</li> <li>Strong foundation in microeconomics, industrial economics and/or econometrics;</li> <li>High degree of numeracy and comfort with data manipulation are essential, familiarity with econometric techniques desirable;</li> <li>Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;</li> <li>Effective oral and written communication skills;</li> <li>Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;</li> <li>Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;</li> <li>Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;</li> <li>Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills; and</li> <li>Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.</li> </ul> <p><strong>To Apply</strong></p> <p>To be considered for this position, please submit the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>CV/Resume</strong> – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;</li> <li><strong>Covering letter</strong> – please describe your interest in the European Competition practice and how this role matches your goals. </li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The internship will take place from Monday 28</span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-fontsize="12">th</span></span><span data-contrast="auto"> June 2027 – Friday 3</span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-fontsize="12">rd</span></span><span data-contrast="auto"> September 2027.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong>Professional Development </strong></p> <p>CRA’s robust <strong><a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/talent-development/">skills development programs</a></strong> and <a href="https://www.crai.com/benefits/"><strong>wellness programming</strong></a> encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. We provide interns a variety of technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and performance coaching over the summer.</p> <p><strong>Work Location Flexibility</strong></p> <p>CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 days a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.</p> <p><strong>Responsible AI Use in Recruiting</strong></p> <p>We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/ai-recruiting/">on our website</a>.  </p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.</p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><em>The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job.  They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.</em></span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Site Reliability Engineer UK | Full-Time The Mission: Source.dev Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework , Security , and the Android Runtime (ART) . Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation. Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. The Core Product: SourceFS SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes. 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed. 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine. True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match. The Cultural Anchor: Own It We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership : "We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.” The Role: Owning Production Reliability & Scale We are looking for a talented Site Reliability Engineer to join us at Source.dev . In this role, you will share ownership of our production environment as a whole—keeping SourceFS fast, observable, and rock-solid under heavy real-world workloads. You will have the autonomy to chase the most critical problems across the stack, with a strong initial focus on performance, where many of our biggest scaling challenges live today. Using your deep knowledge of the Linux stack and the available tools, you’ll root cause bugs, eliminate tail-latency spikes, and turn deep telemetry insights into lasting reliability and ultra performant builds. What You’ll Work On End-to-End Production Reliability & Root-Cause Analysis: Share ownership for production health—leading deep-dive investigations into anomalies, resource contention, OOMs, and partnering with core engineers to turn findings into lasting systemic fixes. Performance Diagnostics & Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, network, and disk I/O bottlenecks in production and benchmark environments. Linux Systems & Storage Tuning: Analyze and tune Linux kernel parameters, filesystems, caching layers, and cloud compute/storage configurations to improve reliability, eliminate tail latency, and maximize I/O throughput. Observability & Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust SLIs/SLOs, telemetry dashboards, and reproducible benchmarking suites to track overall system health and catch regressions under heavy concurrent workloads. Scaling Build Infrastructure: Optimize compute, caching, and ephemeral storage utilization across massive build workloads (Android, Yocto, and beyond) running on high-core cloud environments. Ideal Candidate Profile Holistic SRE & Linux Systems Mindset: You approach systems as a whole and bring deep, hands-on expertise troubleshooting, observing, and tuning Linux infrastructure at scale. You confidently use OS tracing tools like perf, eBPF and flamegraphs to isolate root causes across CPU, memory, and I/O layers, paired with strong systems programming skills (C, Rust). Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale CI/CD systems, build infrastructure, or I/O-heavy distributed workloads. Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality—you see a friction point in production or the developer journey and don’t stop until it’s resolved. Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions. Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant engineer, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate—someone who leads with kindness. Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork. A Note on Our Search We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches. Why Join Source.dev ? AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices. Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware. Early-Stage Ownership : You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one. Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers. title: Software Engineer (Elite Motorsport)
description: <h3><strong>Software Engineer (Motorsport)</strong></h3> <h3><strong>DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS?</strong></h3> <p>Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5,000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.</p> <p>In Motorsport, Catapult’s SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA, nine Formula 1 teams - including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team - the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years - Audi, Porsche, and Toyota - and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR. </p> <p>We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.</p> <h3><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic <strong>Software Engineer (Motorsport)</strong> to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.<br><br>Based in the London office (3 days a week), you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, focussing on one or two racing series, and also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite.<br><br>We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO </strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.</li> <li>Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.</li> <li>Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.</li> <li>Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.</li> <li>Contribute to code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.</li> <li>Maintain and enhance software reliability.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Degree in computer science, or another scientific or technical subject.</li> <li>A passion for sport.</li> <li>2+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.</li> <li>A proven track record of building applications in C/C++, or another object-oriented language.</li> <li>Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.</li> <li>An aptitude for working with complex data.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.</li> <li>A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.</li> <li>Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.</li> <li>An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.</li> <li>Experience developing applications that process video.</li> <li>Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.</li> <li>Prior experience working in motorsport is an advantage.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHY CATAPULT? </strong></h3> <ul> <li>We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.</li> <li>We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.</li> <li>Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you’ll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures.</li> <li>We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.</li> <li>We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave.</li> </ul> <p>Whether you are interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. We look for people that fit into our team culture, those who actively contribute and individuals who are excited about what they do. </p> <p>In order to build the future of sports performance, we need the brightest talent. If you think you can contribute to the empowering, enjoyable and exciting Catapult environment, then we invite you to apply.</p> <p>All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.</p> <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to <strong>Unleash the Potential</strong> of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,800 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  </p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. </p> <h4><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> to help build the Perch camera system, </p> <p>Based in London (hybrid), you will work across platform, perception, and ML systems. You will help us improve how we collect, process, and analyze performance data at scale, spanning from devices collecting real-time to backend services and ML infrastructure. All of which will have a direct impact on customers and their experiences with the product.</p> <p>This role suits a strong generalist who has seen many parts of engineering. Implement security controls, permission models and guardrails that mitigate AI-specific risks and ensure responsible agent behaviour. Collaborate with the wider engineering team, documenting architectural decisions, sharing technical insights and ensuring changes are validated against meaningful evaluation criteria before release. Experience designing evaluation and observability systems for non-deterministic applications, using tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry or custom evaluation pipelines. An understanding of AI-specific security challenges, including prompt injection, data exfiltration and tool misuse. A pragmatic, engineering-led approach to problem-solving, with the ability to balance experimentation with production reliability, performance and maintainability. Intellectual curiosity and a desire to stay at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technical landscape. ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE WE'D LOVE TO SEE Experience deploying and operating local or self-hosted language models. Familiarity with model-serving technologies such as vLLM, Ollama or llama.cpp, including quantisation and GPU optimisation. Experience fine-tuning or distilling models for domain-specific applications. Experience with Microsoft Azure, containerised environments and Kubernetes. Exposure to construction technology, BIM, AEC or 3D spatial data. Contributions to the wider AI engineering community through open-source projects, technical publications, talks or personal projects. title: Associate, Investment Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide</span></p> <p>For further details please visit <a href="http://www.pantheon.com">www.pantheon.com</a></p></div><p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong></p> <p>The Associate of Private Credit Investment Analytics will help build the development of Pantheon’s private credit data and intelligence capability, transforming investment data into structured, decision-ready insight for Portfolio Management teams. </p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of Investment, Data and Operations, and will focus on strengthening the firm’s ability to generate consistent, comparable, and actionable intelligence from credit portfolio data — across funds, GPs, structures, and geographies. </p> <p>The Associate will help architect and operate scalable analytical frameworks that standardize how private credit data is defined, sourced, governed, and translated into insight. The role will partner closely with Portfolio Management, Investment Data Operations and Data Engineering teams to embed credit analytics into Pantheon’s evolving data platforms, reducing reliance on bespoke spreadsheets and increasing transparency, comparability, and confidence </p> <p>This is a high-impact opportunity to shape Pantheon’s private credit data & analytics capability at a time of significant growth and platform transformation</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help build private credit investment analytics across Pantheon to help evaluate and monitor investments.</li> <li>Act as an analytics partner to Investment and Portfolio Management teams, translating complex investment needs into structured data requirements and analytical frameworks.</li> <li>Support the definition, sourcing, and validation of investment-relevant datasets, ensuring analytical outputs are complete, comparable, and decision-ready.</li> <li>Deliver differentiated actionable insights by combining internal investment operations data with GP-reported and external market data, moving beyond descriptive reporting to comparative, diagnostic, and thematic analysis.</li> <li>Represent the data and analytics interface with GPs and external data/technology providers, shaping data standards, templates, and requirements to improve transparency, coverage, and usability.</li> <li>Develop Investment Analytics to become a business-facing function with a product mindset, creating a roadmap that prioritises initiatives based on investment impact, adoption, and measurable decision enablement.<strong> </strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Knowledge and Experience Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience in private markets, with exposure to portfolio data, analytics or investment operations </li> <li>Strong analytical mindset with demonstrated ability to support investment or portfolio decision-making, using advanced & emerging AI toolkit to elevate the speed, rigor, and quality of insight generation</li> <li>Strong understanding of data governance, comparability challenges, and portfolio transparency </li> <li>Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels </li> <li>Proven ability to partner effectively with investment professionals and influence senior stakeholders </li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate complex information clearly and concisely </li> <li>Track record of delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines </li> <li>Curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies that enhance investment intelligence and operational effectiveness</li> <li>Experience with working 3<sup>rd</sup> party providers, data vendors & offshore teams </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Experience </strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with modern data environments and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Python, Databricks, DevOps, Snowflake). </li> <li>Experience systemising investment analytics within centralized data platforms. </li> <li>Exposure to automation or advanced analytical techniques to enhance portfolio monitoring </li> <li>Deep understanding of private credit structures, performance drivers, and portfolio monitoring</li> <li>Professional qualification (CFA, ACA, ACCA, IMC) or equivalent experience preferred but not essential </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. You may be required to perform other job-related duties as reasonably requested by your manager.</strong></p> <p><strong>Pantheon is an Equal Opportunities employer, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't perfectly align we'd still encourage you to apply.</strong></p> <p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com . A Hybrid working model We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. The role HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients. We're looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology. You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You'll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum. Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you'll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why. What you'll do Lead the programme Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures. Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making. Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives. Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions. Drive delivery Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies. Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery. Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood. Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most. Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk. Align clients and stakeholders Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations. Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives. Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity. Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action. Deliver measurable outcomes Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads. Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered. Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action. Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle. What you'll bring Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders. A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments. Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control. The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change. The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations. Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting. A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives. Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous. What success looks like A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes. Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed. Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams. Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance. Measurable client outcomes, with clear evidence of adoption, business impact and value delivered. A programme that meets its objectives while adapting effectively as priorities and requirements evolve. #LI-HYBRID #LI-RH1 Why work here: At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. Inclusion and Impact WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. title: Senior Sales Engineer - UK
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers. This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success. This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team. In this role, you will: Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations. Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry. Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc. Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use. Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers. Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs. Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles. Work in multiple levels of the technology stack. Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails. Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline. 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity. Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management. Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations. Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems. Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems. Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages. An ideal candidate also has: MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline. Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language. Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs. Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications. Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.). Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles. Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here . You will work with the CFO to establish a scalable and efficient framework fit for a dynamic, global software business - tackling everything from digital services taxes to leveraging new tax technologies.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and strategic thinking</strong> over years of experience. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, a professional qualification in accounting and tax and demonstrable exposure to global tax considerations in a multinational context.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region, or may be office based in London, UK</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Managing and coordinating the preparation and review of corporate tax, VAT, and other relevant tax returns for our entities, ensuring timely and accurate filings</li> <li>Working with external advisers to develop transfer pricing documentation and tax planning initiatives and lead their implementation</li> <li>Acting as a key point of contact for tax authority audits and enquiries, preparing responses and supporting documentation in collaboration with external advisors.</li> <li>Identifying opportunities to streamline and improve tax processes, controls, and data management to enhance efficiency and accuracy particularly using technology and automation</li> <li>Managing and running tax provisioning and reporting under IFRS, including calculating effective tax rates and preparing tax-related disclosures for financial statements</li> <li>Working closely with the wider finance team, legal, and business operations to provide tax support and ensure cross-functional alignment</li> title: Sales Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London | 💰 £60k – £80k base salary | £100k – £135k OTE  + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Benefits</a></p> <h3><strong>Our Monzo Business team ⭐</strong></h3> <p>Monzo Business helps businesses manage their money, and more than a million businesses (1 in 6!) in the UK bank with us. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe 🚀</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. Now we’re looking for a Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives and help us turn what we’re learning into a repeatable, effective sales motion.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll coach your team, help them deliver great results and use what you see every day to make the way we sell better. You’ll work closely with Revenue Operations (RevOps), Product and other teams to improve our processes and customer journeys.</p> <p>You’ll also help build an AI-first sales motion from the start. We want someone who’s curious about AI and automation, actively experiments with new tools and can help the team spend more time on conversations that matter.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a team of Account Executives.</strong> Manage a pod of 6–8 people and be accountable for its performance, from reaching the right businesses and converting opportunities to customer activation and quality. Translate the wider Business strategy and set clear expectations, understand what’s driving results and act when performance needs to improve.</li> <li><strong>Coaching and developing your team.</strong> Spend time listening to calls, reviewing opportunities and giving clear, regular feedback. Help each person build their skills and confidence, recognise great work and address underperformance fairly. Help hire and onboard new team members as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Building the sales motion.</strong> Turn what you and your team learn into better ways of working. Spot friction in lead handling, follow-up, handovers and the sales process; test improvements, measure their impact and share what works so we can build a repeatable playbook.</li> <li><strong>Staying close to customers.</strong> We expect Sales Managers to also take a few sales calls each week and make a few sales a month. Use what you learn from customers and the sales journey to coach the team, identify product needs and improve the motion. Most of your time will be spent leading the team and improving how we work.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our Products.</strong> Share what you learn from customers with Product to help shape our proposition and priorities, and use what we learn to improve how we sell.</li> <li><strong>Putting AI and automation to work.</strong> Experiment with tools, agents and workflows that help the team research prospects, prepare for conversations, follow up or learn from calls. Work with specialist teams to test ideas responsibly, understand their impact and help the team adopt what works.</li> <li><strong>Making good decisions with data.</strong> Use pipeline, conversion, activation, productivity and quality data to understand where the team is doing well and where customers or opportunities are getting stuck. Keep the pipeline accurate and work with RevOps on reporting and forecasting.</li> <li><strong>Working as one team.</strong> Bring frontline insight to RevOps, Product, Marketing and Operations. Help shape the tools, processes and customer journeys Sales needs, and work together to solve problems that affect your team and customers.</li> <li><strong>Earning customers’ trust.</strong> Build a culture that puts customers first. Coach your team to understand their needs, represent Monzo accurately and deliver good outcomes. Raise concerns early and work with Risk, Compliance and Legal when needed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ve managed and developed a sales team. You can share examples of how you’ve coached individuals, given feedback and improved performance, including when conversations were difficult.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses in a relatively high-volume environment. You can balance an efficient process with thoughtful, customer-focused conversations.</li> <li>You’re a builder. You’ve spotted a problem in how a team sells, tried a better approach and helped people put it into practice. You’re comfortable making progress when the playbook is still being written.</li> <li>You’ve actively experimented with AI or automation at work and are keen to explore what agents and new workflows can do. You can tell us what you tried, the problem you were solving and what you learned.</li> <li>You’re happy to stay hands-on with customers. You enjoy sales conversations yourself and use what you learn to help others improve.</li> <li>You use data to understand performance. You can look at a funnel or pipeline, ask good questions and turn the answers into practical action.</li> <li>You work well with people in different teams. You can explain what your team and customers need, share evidence and help colleagues find solutions together.</li> <li>You care about doing the right thing for customers. You’re comfortable working within clear standards and learning what it takes to sell in a regulated environment.</li> <li>You might have built your experience in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get here.</li> <li>You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t have everything that’s listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h3><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>💰 £60k – £80k base salary, plus on-target commission based on team performance. Total on-target earnings are approximately £100k – £135k</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office. You’ll work from the office at least 3 days a week to stay close to your team.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></h4> <ul> <li>30-minute introductory call with a recruiter</li> <li>A full interview loop covering role-specific skills, behaviours and values</li> <li>A conversation with a member of the team</li> <li>Final interview with the hiring manager at our London office</li> </ul> <p>We’ll share more details about the interview process and timing as you progress. Your schedule is important to us, so we’ll be as flexible as possible.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong> to lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function and to build the legal architecture a public company needs — commercial contracting, corporate governance, intellectual property and compliance — in a software business that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and advise the CEO, CFO and the Board directly.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: <strong>Location</strong>: This role can be home-based in EMEA, or office-based in our London, UK office.</p> <h3><strong>About our team</strong></h3> <p>Canonical’s Legal and Compliance function is a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. It owns the terms on which Ubuntu and our commercial products reach the market: open source and intellectual property licensing, enterprise and channel contracting, data protection, export controls and trade, competition, and the governance a company preparing to list has to be able to evidence.</p> <p>Canonical is founder-led, profitable and growing, and privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. That makes this a function in transition. The work is as much building the architecture — a management layer across two regions, standard contracting positions, controls, policies and records — as it is advising on live matters, and it is done in a company that regularly does things the industry has not done before, so the precedents often do not exist.</p> <p>The team works with Product and Engineering on licensing and IP, with Security on customer assurance, with Finance on listing readiness and controls, and with Sales on the commitments we make to customers. As General Counsel you lead that team, set its standards, and advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board and its committees directly.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the global Legal and Compliance function: set its structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas, so the business gets consistent answers wherever it operates.</li> <li>Build the management layer: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Set the operating cadence of the function: how legal work is taken in and prioritised, what internal clients can expect and when, and how workload and risk are reported to the leadership team.</li> <li>Own public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and support Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Own the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Lead intellectual property and open source licensing strategy: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Own the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition, and AI regulation.</li> <li>Manage litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, and own the external counsel panel, its budget and the quality of its work.</li> <li>Advise on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Qualified as a lawyer, with a law degree or equivalent and an active licence to practise in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>In-house legal leadership in a software or technology company — a business that licenses its own products, rather than one that buys technology to run its operations.</li> <li>Commercial technology contracting: enterprise software and subscription agreements, channel and reseller agreements, cloud and services, and hardware manufacturer agreements.</li> <li>Open source licensing: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and how open source communities work in practice.</li> <li>Corporate governance for a listed company, or for one preparing to list: board and committee support, delegated authority, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>Building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English, with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally two to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practising as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we work</strong></p> <p>We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.</li> <li>You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time. </li> <li>You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.</li> <li>You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.</li> <li>You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.</li> <li>You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.</li> </ul> <p>We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.</p> <h4><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h4> <p>💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</strong></p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>30-minute call with our Recruiter</strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team. </strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour interview covering values & ways of working. </strong></li> </ul> <p>To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-TR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. That means experimenting, measuring what changes, and helping the team adopt better ways of working as the technology evolves.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Sales for Monzo Business globally</strong>. Test how inbound, outbound and self-serve journeys work together, and <strong>identify</strong> where a sales conversation makes a meaningful difference.</li> <li><strong>Make growth count</strong>. title: Forward Deployed Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes. This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value. You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams. The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption. - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale. - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation. - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value. - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback. - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path. - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements. - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role. - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria. - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions. - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows. - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively. - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value. - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness. - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences. - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward. - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers. - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows. - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up. - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements. - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo.
